mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above the 5-year moving average precedes a short-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as investors anticipate tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5mo moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive during FEDFUNDS above-median periods, or 5mo moving average crossover does not precede returns with p > 0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
failure_condition: Payrolls growth shows no correlation with SPX 60d returns over 5 years, or IC < 0.05 in rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST (industrial production) below the 12-month average predicts a negative S&P 500 5-day forward return as weak manufacturing signals risk aversion.
failure_condition: HOUST remains above 12mo avg with SPX 5d returns positive, or IC > 0.1 in 3mo window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production) followed within a week by a rise in GDPC1 (goods orders) predicts a positive S&P 500 20-day return as supply chain rebalancing boosts optimism.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12mo avg and GDPC1 > 12mo avg in same window
failure_condition: No significant return correlation over 100 observations, or INDPRO/GDPC1 interaction fails to predict returns (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 3% for three consecutive months in a tightening regime, S&P 500 60-day forward returns trend positive as expectations of rate cuts persist.
failure_condition: No significant return effect in 3 tightening phases, or FEDFUNDS stays below 3% without return benefit.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in RSAFS (retail sales) above the 90th percentile triggers a positive S&P 500 20-day return as strong consumer demand boosts market sentiment.
failure_condition: No significant return effect in 10 such spikes, or IC < 0.05 in event window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of declining CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% suggests central bank patience, resulting in a positive S&P 500 5-day forward return.
failure_condition: No positive returns during 5 such periods, or IC > 0.2 in test.

mechanism_narrative: A negative interaction between INDPRO (declining) and GDPC1 (rising) within a month signals supply disruption and signals a negative S&P 500 20-day return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12mo avg and GDPC1 > 12mo avg in same month
failure_condition: No consistent negative return in 10 such events, or interaction fails to predict returns (p > 0.1).
